messages.content: Can you shortlist 5 CRM tools for our 20-person sales team? We care about pipeline management, automated email sequences, and transparent per-user pricing.

Here is our shortlist of **5 CRM tools** tailored for a 20-person B2B sales team:

1. **HubSpot Sales Hub**
   - **Target Plan:** Professional ($90 - $100/seat/month billed annually).
   - **Cost for 20 seats:** ~$1,800 - $2,000/month.

2. **Pipedrive**
   - **Target Plan:** Professional ($49/seat/month billed annually) or Advanced ($24/seat/month).
   - **Cost for 20 seats (Professional):** ~$980/month.

3. **Close CRM**
   - **Target Plan:** Professional ($99/user/month) or Startup ($49/user/month).
   - **Cost for 20 seats (Professional):** ~$1,980/month.

4. **Zoho CRM**
   - **Target Plan:** Professional ($23/user/month billed annually).
   - **Cost for 20 seats (Professional):** ~$460/month.

5. **Folk CRM**
   - **Target Plan:** Premium ($29/member/month) or Standard ($18/member/month).
   - **Cost for 20 seats (Premium):** ~$580/month.
What are the best serverless Postgres hosting providers right now for an early-stage SaaS, and what are their current starter/pro pricing tiers?

As of **November 3**, here is the breakdown of top serverless Postgres options:

1. **Neon:** Launch Plan is $19/month (includes 10 GB storage, database branching).
2. **Supabase:** Pro Plan is $25/month (8 GB included database disk, Auth, Realtime).
3. **AWS Aurora Serverless v2:** Billed per ACU at ~$0.12 per ACU-hour. Minimum 0.5 ACU baseline (~$43/month).
4. **Tembo:** Starting at $10 - $45/month with specialized Postgres stacks.
What are the pricing models and cold starts for Postgres hosting providers like Neon, Supabase, and Render?

Here is the Postgres hosting comparison from **Last Tuesday (2026-11-03)**:

- **Neon:** Launch plan is $19/month with 10 GB storage and branching.
- **Supabase:** Pro plan is $25/month with 8 GB database storage.
- **Render:** Starter tier is $7/month, Standard is $20/month.
On Monday we shortlisted 5 CRM tools for a 20-person sales team. Has any of them changed pricing or shipped something big since?

### CRM Shortlist Delta & Pricing Audit (Since Monday)

On Monday, we shortlisted **5 CRM tools** for your 20-person sales team: **HubSpot Sales Hub**, **Pipedrive**, **Close**, **Zoho CRM**, and **Folk CRM**.

Here is the verified delta analysis based on live web searches:

| CRM Tool | Baseline Plan (Monday) | Current Status & Changes Since Monday | Change Verdict | Citation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **HubSpot Sales Hub** | $90 - $100/seat/mo (Professional) | **No pricing change.** Continuing rollout of HubSpot Breeze AI agents. | **Unchanged** | [[1]](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/sales) |
| **Pipedrive** | $24 - $49/seat/mo (Advanced/Pro) | **Pricing unchanged.** Pipedrive recently refreshed their AI Smart Docs. | **Unchanged** | [[2]](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/pricing) |
| **Close CRM** | $49 - $99/user/mo (Startup/Pro) | **Pricing steady.** Shipped automated call transcripts. | **Unchanged** | [[3]](https://www.close.com/pricing) |
| **Zoho CRM** | $14 - $23/user/mo (Standard/Pro) | **No pricing change.** Consistent pricing tiers for 20 seats (~$460/mo total). | **Unchanged** | [[4]](https://www.zoho.com/crm/pricing.html) |
| **Folk CRM** | $18 - $29/member/mo (Standard/Premium) | **No changes.** Folk remains popular for lightweight contact management. | **Unchanged** | [[5]](https://www.folk.app/pricing) |

### Key Takeaway for Your 20-Person Team
- **Budget / Cost Stability:** All 5 shortlisted vendors have kept baseline pricing intact.
- **Velocity Pick:** **Close** and **Pipedrive** continue to represent the best value-to-speed ratio (~$980 - $1,980/mo total).
- **All-in-One Pick:** **HubSpot** remains the premier marketing-aligned choice at ~$1,800 - $2,000/mo.
